say:1:1611166001:0.text: Magister Merlin, we have preliminary results from Gervan's interrogation.
say:1:1611166001:0.source_cn: ……梅林大人，对格墨文的审讯已经有了初步结果。
say:1:1611166001:0.male: Magister Merlin, we have preliminary results from Gervan's interrogation.
say:1:1611166001:0.female: Magister Merlin, we have preliminary results from Gervan's interrogation.

say:2:1611166002:0.text: According to his testimony, he initially made contact with the Syndicate seeking a cure for his legs. After they healed him, he became fully indebted to them.
say:2:1611166002:0.source_cn: 据他自己供述，为了治疗腿疾，他早与黑金商会有了联系，在...
say:2:1611166002:0.male: According to his testimony, he initially made contact with the Syndicate seeking a cure for his legs. After they healed him, he became fully indebted to them.
say:2:1611166002:0.female: According to his testimony, he initially made contact with the Syndicate seeking a cure for his legs. After they healed him, he became fully indebted to them.

say:3:1611166003:1.text: Recently, the Syndicate contacted him abruptly, threatening to expose his use of dark magic treatments unless he helped them steal classified materials from your tower.
say:3:1611166003:1.source_cn: 这次是黑金商会派人突然找上他，以公开他接受黑魔法疗伤一...

say:4:1611166004:1.text: This placed him under significant duress.
say:4:1611166004:1.source_cn: 这给格墨文带来了很大心理压力。
say:4:1611166004:1.male: This placed him under significant duress.
say:4:1611166004:1.female: This placed him under significant duress.

say:5:1611166005:1.text: We believe Headmaster Leymar discovered the altered selection exam and noticed Gervan's miraculous recovery. He suspected corruption in this exam and intended to intervene.
say:5:1611166005:1.source_cn: 我们判断，校长雷蒙意外发现选拔试题被临时更改，加上发现...
say:5:1611166005:1.male: We believe Headmaster Leymar discovered the altered selection exam and noticed Gervan's miraculous recovery. He suspected corruption in this exam and intended to intervene.
say:5:1611166005:1.female: We believe Headmaster Leymar discovered the altered selection exam and noticed Gervan's miraculous recovery. He suspected corruption in this exam and intended to intervene.

say:6:1611166006:1.text: The headmaster didn't want to see a talented mage throw his life away, so he confronted Gervan, hoping he would come clean.
say:6:1611166006:1.source_cn: 作为校长，雷蒙不愿见到一位有天赋的魔法师走上歧途，于是...
say:6:1611166006:1.male: The headmaster didn't want to see a talented mage throw his life away, so he confronted Gervan, hoping he would come clean.
say:6:1611166006:1.female: The headmaster didn't want to see a talented mage throw his life away, so he confronted Gervan, hoping he would come clean.

say:7:1611166007:1.text: However, it was also the critical period for Gervan's family to decide on their next heir. He feared the scandal would ruin his reputation and cost him his inheritance.
say:7:1611166007:1.source_cn: 但当前正是格墨文的家族确定爵位继承人的时刻，格墨文担心...
say:7:1611166007:1.male: However, it was also the critical period for Gervan's family to decide on their next heir. He feared the scandal would ruin his reputation and cost him his inheritance.
say:7:1611166007:1.female: However, it was also the critical period for Gervan's family to decide on their next heir. He feared the scandal would ruin his reputation and cost him his inheritance.

say:8:1611166008:1.text: Combined with the Syndicate's threats, Gervan made a terrible choice. In a panic, he killed the headmaster.
say:8:1611166008:1.source_cn: 再加上黑金商会的威胁，让格墨文做出了错误的决定，他在冲...
say:8:1611166008:1.male: Combined with the Syndicate's threats, Gervan made a terrible choice. In a panic, he killed the headmaster.
say:8:1611166008:1.female: Combined with the Syndicate's threats, Gervan made a terrible choice. In a panic, he killed the headmaster.

say:9:1611166009:1.text: While Gervan hasn't explicitly named him, our suspicions were correct: Cyran was deeply involved. He appears to be the true architect of this conspiracy.
say:9:1611166009:1.source_cn: 虽然格墨文并未言明，但我们之前的猜测没错，整件事与迪尔...
say:9:1611166009:1.male: While Gervan hasn't explicitly named him, our suspicions were correct: Cyran was deeply involved. He appears to be the true architect of this conspiracy.
say:9:1611166009:1.female: While Gervan hasn't explicitly named him, our suspicions were correct: Cyran was deeply involved. He appears to be the true architect of this conspiracy.

say:10:1611166010:1.text: Unfortunately, we still lack concrete proof. Gervan's vague testimony won't convince the stubborn nobles and certain royal court members. Their blind faith in Cyran... astounding, to say the least.
say:10:1611166010:1.source_cn: 但可惜的是，我们尚无足够证据证明这一点。只靠格墨文不明...
say:10:1611166010:1.male: Unfortunately, we still lack concrete proof. Gervan's vague testimony won't convince the stubborn nobles and certain royal court members. Their blind faith in Cyran... astounding, to say the least.
say:10:1611166010:1.female: Unfortunately, we still lack concrete proof. Gervan's vague testimony won't convince the stubborn nobles and certain royal court members. Their blind faith in Cyran... astounding, to say the least.

say:11:1611166011:1.text: I'll continue pursuing other avenues to gather evidence against him. Following your leads, I've dispatched agents to Whiteridge to investigate.
say:11:1611166011:1.source_cn: 我会试着从其他方面入手，继续查找迪尔格雷的罪证。根据你...

say:11:1611166011:1.female: I'll continue pursuing other avenues to gather evidence against him. Following your leads, I've dispatched agents to Whiteridge to investigate.

say:12:1611166012:1.text: I hope we'll find something useful...
say:12:1611166012:1.male: I hope we'll find something useful...
say:12:1611166012:1.female: I hope we'll find something useful...

say:13:1611166013:1.text: Regarding Zorya's situation... I must apologize. I initiated her release, but encountered resistance from several powerful nobles.
say:13:1611166013:1.source_cn: 对了，关于佐尔娅的事情……我很抱歉，我启动了释放流程，...

say:13:1611166013:1.female: Regarding Zorya's situation... I must apologize. I initiated her release, but encountered resistance from several powerful nobles.

say:14:1611166014:1.text: Although I serve under the Queen, I've had to suspend the release process to maintain the current political balance.
say:14:1611166014:1.source_cn: 我虽然是王后陛下的属官，但为了保持当前宫廷内部的局势平...

say:14:1611166014:1.female: Although I serve under the Queen, I've had to suspend the release process to maintain the current political balance.

say:15:1611166015:0.text: But rest assured, I will continue <style="highlight">investigating</style> to find definitive proof of her innocence.
